questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I lived at Livensa Living Marina Real near the beach very close to Maritim station. Its more on the expensive side, but it made my stay very comfortable.

questions.answer: most people live off campus so its not a big deal. just dont scammed and talk with a truster host before sending any money or anything. using the agencies available is also a good idea.

questions.answer: every help you needed was available. the UV is very good on this point

questions.answer: the classes were like first come first served, but they were very kind and they expanded the class (the number of students) so there was more places for other students.

questions.answer: it was okay not that hard

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: be open, people will not talk to you if you have a closed personality and vibe. you have to give an open energy to receive i as well. people are kind and keep in mind they are feeling exactly what you are feeling. you guys are all away from family and friend. so this is your new life for the next 6 months. make friends it will be so fun afterwards when you will visit one another

questions.answer:
be prepared that school will be hard.
its okay everything will be fine, have fun.
you can have good and bad days just like you have good and bad days in Denmark. Just rememeber to have more good than bad days. you are responsable for your own happiness. do things alone and challenge yourself <3

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: the friendships and relationships that i have created. Ive also gotten to know myself better and challenged parts of myself and Got out of my comfortzone.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: creating a whole new life for yourself and completely alone.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: do it and dont think twice. dont let your fear get the best of you. its scary, yes, but its so Worth it!!!
